[[Category:Philosophical method]][[Category:Scientific method]]
'''Thought experiments''' concretise abstract ideas and their implications via imaginary scenarios. 

== Application ==

=== Invalidation of hypothesis ===

An thought experiment can often be used to invalidate a hypothesis, if a contradiction or an otherwise absurd conclusion can be drawn from an imaginary scenario<ref>{{#cite:Q1837}}</ref>
